netAmountAtRisk.description: Net Amount at Risk is based upon the Death Benefit, Account Value, and is computed as set forth in "Cost of Insurance Charge"

deemedAccountValue.description: For the purposes of calculating the deemed cash value for CVAT policies and the necessary premium test - 4 percent interest rate, Current Charges, Same death benefit option as base policy will be used.

initialPremiumRequestAmount.description: Initial premium Amount paid by the party

initialPremiumAppliedAmount.description: Initial premium Amount applied on the policy

initialPaymentAmountReceivedDate.description: This is the date the Initial premium Payment is received in the Home Office. We will allow up to [14] days from the Policy Start Date to receive the Initial Payment. If we have not received the Initial Payment within this time period, the policy is not considered inforce and the client has another [16] days for us to receive the clients funds If the clients funds are received from the client’s bank in those [16] days, the Policy Start Date and Issue Date will be the day those Funds are received A new Policy Delivery date is established. In order to minimize any negative customer experience and delay in issuing policies, se2 must inform SBL immediately upon any failure of electronic payment method to successfully fund the Initial Payment. Our system must track this date and restrict a Policy Start Date that does not meet these requirements.
